per_window.ps-ns: unresolved. The 15N relaxation study of free NGAL that accompanies the 1NGL structure, the likely source of BMRB 4267, is abstract only: overall tau_c 13.3 ns for a 179-residue monomer and dynamics said to correlate with barrel features, no residue values (R4267-J1, r1).
per_window.us-ms: search_insufficient for free NGAL (J2). The only CPMG data observe the receptor domain exchanging with NGAL (kex 1200-1300 s-1; J12) and are binding kinetics; receptor binding broadens NGAL peaks without a rate (J13).
per_window.slower_than_ms: search_insufficient for free NGAL (J4). Candesartan binding to C87S siderocalin gives slow-to-intermediate exchange with more than one bound peak set and model rates of 7.9-63 s-1, but induced fit and parallel binding fit equally well (J14, binding kinetics).
per_window.undetermined: Unbound tagged siderocalin by HDX-MS at 37 °C: fast uptake in the N-terminal segment and alpha-helix, protected barrel, no rates (J3, unresolved). Ligand protection by aferric and ferric enterobactin (J5, J6) and Lys/Arg footprinting (J7). Crystals: W79 and R81 rotamers vary with ligand (J8, structure_only) while the calyx backbone does not move across 73 molecules (J9); human-mouse R92 comparison (J10); crystal versus solution flexibility abstract (J11). Mouse homolog titration (J15) and MD with a suspected unit error (J16).

protein_summary.wt_apo_answer: Not determined: no row measures us-ms exchange in free NGAL, and the 1999 15N relaxation study of the apo entry construct (1NGL) was read as an abstract only, so no site, rate or population can be given.
protein_summary.deposition_readback: No deposited-data readback file (outputs/deposition/4267.json) was present when this was drafted.
questions_for_gina: Is BMRB 4267 the 15N relaxation set of Coles et al. 1999 (doi:10.1006/jmbi.1999.2755, apo 1NGL)? If so, its full text or the deposited R1/R2/NOE values are needed before any window verdict for the entry.

Recombinant NGAL often carries copurified bacterial siderophores (the receptor study refolded NGAL from guanidinium to remove them; the mouse candesartan sample may contain aferric enterobactin). Should 'apo' for this entry require such a ligand-removal step?
protein_summary.buffer_note: Most solution data use non-entry constructs: C87S siderocalin (receptor and candesartan studies), a GS-tagged protein for HDX-MS and footprinting (paper numbering = entry + 1), and mature protein without Met for the phosphoserine crystal (precursor numbering = entry + 19). HDX and footprinting are in PBS at 37 °C; the candesartan titrations are in 100 mM sodium phosphate with DMSO, with no buffer control at the calyx. Crystals are grown at pH 4.1-4.5 (or 7.9 for 9JDO) and measured cryo-cooled. Mature author numbering maps to entry +1. The second read raised no flags for this case.
